name: morphicons
role: Morph one SVG icon path into another by a progress value; DOM-free core runs in Node
summary: morphicons matches points between two unrelated icon paths (stroked or filled, on a 24 grid) and interpolates rotation, scale and translation separately. Its root entry is a pure core: build a plan once, then turn any progress in 0..1 into an SVG path string, so a morph can follow capture time with no spring or DOM.
use_when: An icon becomes a different icon (menu to X, play to pause) and the in-between shape should be matched, not cross-faded
Morph frames from a progress value in a seek-driven scene or a Node script
Icons from Lucide, Tabler, Heroicons or Feather on one 24 grid
avoid_when: Tweening arbitrary SVG attributes or long paths: svg-js, anime-js or motion-js
Looking up which icon to use or its licence: iconify
Morphing large illustrations or text outlines: not what its icon matching is built for
notes: 2026-11-27: the lead's install and licence lines held; its playground icons carry their own ISC and MIT licences. The pure core it called undocumented is exported from the root entry and works in Node.

assessment.rationale: npm morphicons 2.0.2 published 2026-10-24, MIT, zero runtime dependencies. No catalogue tool matches points between two unrelated icon paths; its core is seekable by progress, so it fits capture.

evidence.result: Lucide menu to x via morphicons pure core (Node 22.19.0): frames.json byte-identical across two processes, 3 subpaths, 192 commands per frame, coords within 4..20 to 6..18 across progress 0..1, 5 frames rasterised by resvg 0.47.0 into a 1200x240 contact sheet, inspected.
evidence.scope: One stroke icon pair, DOM-free core, progress 0 to 1 in five steps, macOS arm64; not filled icons, bindings, springs, other grids or in-browser capture.
